item.title: github: New controls and chat improvements in Copilot for JetBrains
item.description:
GitHub Copilot for JetBrains now lets users control the default model and MCP server, and includes updates that make diagnostics easier to resolve. The release also improves chat navigation and account controls.

  • Source: GitHub
